name: TENAGA
recent: Tenaga Nasional 近期与 IOI Corp 及中小企业财团签署合资协议，开发 500MW 太阳能加储能项目；同时通过可持续发展伊斯兰债券筹资 48 亿令吉，并持续进行电网现代化。最新季度营收环比增长 6.6%，但净利环比下降 19.0%。
notable: 与 IOI Corp 旗下公司及中小企业财团签署合资协议，开发 500MWac 太阳能光伏及 250MW/1,000MWh 电池储能项目，TNB Renewables 持股 70%。
通过可持续发展伊斯兰债券筹集 48 亿令吉。
宣布未来五年预计新增 9,000MW 电力需求，并推进电网强化与现代化。
risks: 最新季度净利环比下降 19.0%，净利率由 6.4% 降至 4.9%。
雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）近期多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 182.36 亿令吉，环比增长 6.6%，同比增长 8.3%；净利为 8.888 亿令吉，环比下降 19.0%，同比下降 23.3%，净利率为 4.9%。

recent_en: Tenaga Nasional recently signed a joint venture agreement with IOI Corp and an SME consortium to develop a 500MW solar-plus-storage project; it also raised RM4.8 billion via sustainability sukuk and continues grid modernisation. Latest quarter revenue rose 6.6% QoQ while net profit fell 19.0% QoQ.
notable_en: Signed a joint venture agreement with IOI Corp's subsidiary and an SME consortium to develop a 500MWac solar PV and 250MW/1,000MWh battery storage project, with TNB Renewables holding 70%.
Raised RM4.8 billion via sustainability sukuk.
Announced an expected additional 9,000MW electricity demand over the next five years and is advancing grid strengthening and modernisation.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit fell 19.0% QoQ, with net margin down from 6.4% to 4.9%.
Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) and Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (KWAP) have made multiple recent shareholding change notifications.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM18.236 billion, up 6.6% QoQ and 8.3% YoY; net profit was RM888.8 million, down 19.0% QoQ and 23.3% YoY, with a net margin of 4.9%.
